name: Salamandre 1
description: Sapeur incendiaire creusant des tunnels enflammés sous les fortifications ennemies pour les faire s'effondrer.

subject.archetype: Salamandre 1 — Héritiers des cendres Common spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Peaux noircies avec veines lumineuses orange. Armures de métal fondu et cendres compactées. Cheveux comme de la fumée. Cicatrices tribales.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's decrease ability (opposite_side) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Everyday working pose, natural stance — character shown in their normal operational state — Dimensional pressure pushing against cards on the opposite side of the board

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Ember Orange
palette_names.role: primary_accent — glowing veins and fire effects

palette_names.name: Charcoal Black
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — scorched skin and armor base

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Flat ambient light with subtle shadows, documentary-style natural lighting

camera.angle: eye-level direct portrait creating a sense of honest documentation

scenography.setting: Smoldering ruins of a destroyed settlement, half-melted structures glowing from residual heat, rivers of slow-moving lava carving through the devastated landscape
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Rising embers carried by thermal updrafts, heat distortion shimmer in the air, thick smoke plumes blocking the sky, volcanic ash falling like snow, plus force field — visible compression field squeezing opposition values down visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Sapeur incendiaire creusant des tunnels enflammés sous les fortifications ennemies pour les faire s'effondrer.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Les Héritiers des Cendres sont les survivants de la Grande Purification — un cataclysme qui consuma leurs mondes entiers. Leur existence est une vengeance perpétuelle.

card_metadata.composition_directive: Medium close-up portrait (chest-up) showing character face and upper torso in their working environment
